description: This source file defines the EditTaskFragment class, which manages the UI screen for creating or editing tasks within a to-do list Android application. It handles user input, interacts with a TaskViewModel, and manages fragment lifecycle events.

classes.name: EditTaskFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass responsible for adding and editing tasks, handling user input, and interacting with the task ViewModel.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the fragment to its context and sets up the Listener callback.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, retrieves task ID from arguments, and sets up the ViewModel.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and returns the root view.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI interactions, initializes task data if editing, and binds data to views.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up the binding reference to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the fragment, optionally with a task ID argument.
